<function name="Play" parent="CSoundPatch" type="classfunc">
	<description>Starts to play the sound. This will reset the sound's volume and pitch to their default values. See <page>CSoundPatch:PlayEx</page></description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Example usage</description>
	<code>
local mysound = CreateSound( "test.wav" )
mysound:Play()
	</code>

</example>
